# Jarvis Strategies

> Jarvis Strategies helps trades, construction, and manufacturing companies across the Okanagan (Vernon, Kelowna, Penticton, Kamloops), British Columbia identify, build, and deploy AI systems connected to real operational workflows, and stays on as an ongoing partner.

Led by Scott Jarvis, 18 years in trades and construction operations before moving into AI implementation. The approach is practical-first: use cases have to connect to real workflows (estimating, proposals, documentation, subcontractor coordination), not generic AI hype. Every workflow ships with governance built in — accountability, data boundaries, quality control, transparency.

## Site
- [Homepage](https://jarvisstrategies.com/): Services, governance philosophy, results, about Scott Jarvis, and contact
- [AI Readiness Assessment](https://jarvisstrategies.com/assessment): Free 7-question, 2-minute assessment that scores AI readiness and surfaces use cases
- [Blog index](https://jarvisstrategies.com/blog/): Practical AI thinking for trades and construction — no hype
- [Solutions index](https://jarvisstrategies.com/solutions): Four specific, implemented AI use cases for trades and construction businesses

## Solutions
- [Cut Proposal Turnaround](https://jarvisstrategies.com/solutions/proposal-turnaround): Take construction proposal turnaround from three days to about 90 minutes without losing pricing judgment
- [Fix the Estimating Bottleneck](https://jarvisstrategies.com/solutions/estimating): Which of the six jobs inside "estimating" AI actually helps with, and which it shouldn't touch
- [Get Engineering Time Back](https://jarvisstrategies.com/solutions/engineering-documentation): Cut documentation time 30-40% and reclaim engineer time from compliance paperwork
- [Streamline Subcontractor Coordination](https://jarvisstrategies.com/solutions/subcontractor-coordination): Daily site summaries, RFI triage, and schedule impact analysis for GCs
